global_layer.context: A single continuous take of a busy pedestrian crossing in a big city at night in the rain.
global_layer.description: Dozens of people with umbrellas cross a wide intersection as neon signs reflect on the wet asphalt.

aesthetics.color_scheme: magenta and cyan neon, black wet asphalt, clear and colored umbrellas

audio_baseline.ambience: steady rain, crosswalk beeping signal, traffic hiss, crowd footsteps

lighting_baseline.conditions: night, lit by neon signs and street lights
lighting_baseline.direction: from the signs on the buildings
lighting_baseline.source_consistency: the lighting holds steady for the full clip

environment_baseline.background_setting: tall buildings covered in glowing signs and billboards, a wide zebra crossing

alive_subjects_static.description: a crowd of pedestrians with umbrellas

visual_attributes.clothing: dark coats, a few bright raincoats

camera_cinematography.default_depth_of_field: deep; the whole crossing in focus

segment_basic_info.segment_description: The signal turns and the crowd floods into the crossing from all sides.
segment_basic_info.active_background: rain streaks through the neon light

camera_delta.composition: wide shot, crossing fills the frame

action.motion_detail: hundreds of footsteps splash through puddles, umbrellas bob

segment_basic_info.segment_description: The camera settles at street level as a woman with a clear umbrella walks toward it, neon reflected in the umbrella.

camera_delta.focus: a woman with a clear umbrella

spatial_position.relative_size: one figure larger in the foreground

action.motion_detail: raindrops bead and run down the clear umbrella, neon colors slide across it

ambience_deltas.ambience: rain on umbrellas, close and crisp

special_audio_events.sound_description: a car tire hissing through water
